data.name: Purna
data.gender_notes: Purna is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Purna’, which means ‘complete’, ‘perfect’ or ‘whole’. This name is given to babies born with a sense of completeness, who are believed to be perfect in every way. The name Purna carries the meaning “Complete, Perfect” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Purna usually hope their child will grow to embody complete, perfect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the ultimate goal of spiritual growth – attaining the state of being complete and whole in every way.
data.etymology: Purna belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Complete, Perfect.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Purna total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
